37 y/o #DelrawnSmall was shot & killed by Officer Wayne Isaacs on 7/4/16 in E. NY, Bklyn. Isaacs killed Delrawn in front of his four-month-old son. Today marks 4 years since #DelrawnSmall was killed by NYPD officer Wayne Isaacs.
